summary: [FE][MT] Verify the layout with the new columns is saved per user and does not change another user, and two users saving different free-text spellings at the same time keep both
description_wiki:
*Scenario:* Checks that the column layout is saved per user and that two users saving different spellings at the same time both keep their value.

*Precondition:* Two test users, User A and User B, with View Worklist permission (see [Role & Permission|https://pttep.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sites/TurnaroundManagement/Shared%20Documents/03%20Development/Role%20%26%20Permission%20V.2.xlsx?d=wa5e5a9a2071b4ed7b3ef83c4cf0dffd9&csf=1&web=1&e=3stFwC]) and no saved layout. Worklist {{WL-A}} exists. Work {{WK-5c}} can be prepared with two Work Breakdowns, both with Deck {{Main Deck}}. Two browser contexts are available, one per user.

*Navigation Path:* Planning tab > Plan Card > Worklist item > Worklist page of {{WL-A}} > Column Customization; for the Work Breakdowns, Worklist page > Work {{WK-5c}} > Edit Work Breakdown.
